entities.summary: Otto-Werner Mueller was a German-born conductor. As a long-time professor of conducting at the Curtis Institute of Music and the Juilliard School, Mueller taught many important conductors, such as Rudolf Barshai, Keri-Lynn Wilson and Paavo Järvi.
